objective: Require role-by-role model confirmation when entering every distinct new project, and renewed confirmation when relevant model information updates are detected even in an existing project.
requested: distinguish a new project from a new conversation/session
require user confirmation of model assignments for each distinct new project
require renewed user confirmation when model updates are detected for existing projects
excluded: build asynchronous model-update monitoring or notifications
infer runtime model availability from public announcements
change a confirmed project model profile without user confirmation

requestedItems.description: Specify a one-time, role-by-role confirmation at first substantial model allocation in every distinct project, not every new session.
Require renewed user confirmation when a model/version, price, availability, capability, or relevant benchmark update is detected.

acceptance.description: Active model policy, runtime guidance, and execution allocation state the confirmation triggers and no-silent-change boundary.
Functional assurance claim/limits align with policy and explicitly do not claim automatic detection or prompting.
Semantic, functional, and affected route/allocation checks pass.
